# papyrium-model-epson-lx800

The Epson LX-800, a 9-pin dot-matrix printer of 1987, for Papyrium. It is
an FX-80 descendant speaking ESC/P through `papyrium-language-escp`, with
near letter quality, condensed elite, the IBM PC character table, thirteen
national sets and justification, and without proportional spacing.
`docs/epson-lx800.md` records the behaviour followed and how it differs
from the FX-80.

It prints with `lx800-draft` and `lx800-nlq-roman`, characters extracted
from the LX-800's firmware ROM. The dump available has Cyrillic where the
Western LX-800 has its second NLQ typeface, Sans Serif, so `ESC k 1` prints
in Roman unless a Sans Serif font is given.

## Demonstration page

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rob-smallshire/papyrium/master/docs/images/demo-epson-lx800.png" alt="The epson-lx800 demonstration page" width="100%">

Print it yourself, as PNG and PDF, with `papyrium demo epson-lx800`; `-M`
options set the printer up, such as `-M stationery=green-bar`.

Registered as `epson-lx800` on the `papyrium.model` axis. The options
model the printer's DIP switches and paper:

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `condensed` | `no` | Power on in condensed (switch 1-1) |
| `slashed-zero` | `no` | Print zero with a slash (switch 1-2) |
| `graphics-table` | `no` | Codes 128-255 from the IBM PC table rather than italics, as `ESC t 1` (switch 1-3) |
| `near-letter-quality` | `no` | Power on printing near letter quality (switch 1-5) |
| `character-set` | `usa` | Power-on international set: any of the thirteen `ESC R` sets, by name or number (switches 1-6 to 1-8 give 0-7) |
| `form-length` | `11` | Form length in inches (switch 2-1 gives 11 or 12) |
| `skip-perforation` | `no` | Skip one inch over the perforation (switch 2-3) |
| `auto-line-feed` | `no` | Each carriage return also feeds a line (switch 2-4) |
| `paper-width` | `9.5`, or `8.5` for `sheet` | Paper width in inches, tear-off strips included; the line is centred on it |
| `top-offset` | `19/36` | Inches from the perforation to the top of the first line |
| `stationery` | `fanfold` | The paper: `fanfold` (plain, with tear-off strips), `sheet` (no strips), `green-bar`, `blue-bar`, `music-ruled` |
| `font` | `lx800-draft` | The draft characters: an installed font's name, or the path of a dot font file |
| `nlq-font` | `lx800-nlq-roman` | The NLQ Roman characters, `ESC k 0`: an 18 x 24 dot font's name or file |
| `nlq-sans-serif-font` | none | The NLQ Sans Serif characters, `ESC k 1`; none prints Sans Serif in Roman |

Not modelled yet: user-defined characters limited to codes 58-63 and their
NLQ form, SelecType, and the draft IBM PC graphics characters, which print
nothing until they are decoded from the ROM.
